main_result.statement: In the compressed exact-rank-three heavy-null state, if the normalized complement frame max leverage is epsilon<(1-1/sqrt(2))^2, MSS yields an original-coordinate bipartition with Pi_3 cross product at least D(1-c)delta(epsilon)^3, hence ||p_Q||_inf<=3e[D(1-c)]^(-1/3)delta^(-1). Under D>=1/2,c<=61/64,max leverage<=1/16 this is <339.450 continuously.

first_unpaid_detail: For tau_J+tau_K<=1/32, pay either c<=61/64 with normalized complement leverage at least (1-1/sqrt(2))^2, or c>61/64, unless an existing local/two-pivot/ridge/exact-cross/generated-span exit applies. Arbitrary additional spectrum remains separate.
